updates.new_result: RAKL now separates overlap compatibility, cycle/path coherence, global existence and global uniqueness. Pairwise agreement cannot silently become a global theory; nonunique global states remain an identified set and disconnected coherent components remain a partial atlas.
updates.remaining_gap: No real multi-paper scientific theory-chart benchmark has yet measured whether the richer contract improves synthesis utility or false-globalization rate.

updates.problem: The previous atlas semantics said compatible local charts may glue, but did not executablely distinguish local overlap compatibility from actual global existence/uniqueness or require an applicable local-to-global certificate.
updates.target: Treat arbitrary scientific chart systems as presheaf-like by default; require typed overlap transitions plus either a registered local-to-global theorem/certificate or explicit global existence and uniqueness checks before a unique global portrait can be proposed.
updates.falsifier: If known-answer and real theory packets show pairwise compatibility is sufficient under a simpler always-applicable contract without increasing false global synthesis, retain the simpler contract and remove unnecessary global-coherence machinery.

updates.problem: Pairwise transition maps can each look valid while composition along alternative paths or around a cycle is inconsistent, creating a false global picture.
updates.target: For covers with registered cycles or alternative transport paths, test a declared cycle basis/path family and preserve any composition inconsistency as an immutable obstruction rather than averaging it away.
updates.falsifier: If cycle/path checks do not detect any additional false gluing or improve failure localization beyond pairwise and explicit global-existence tests on frozen real packets, collapse this into the simpler transition/global check.

updates.problem: Synthetic gluing contracts do not show that global-coherence checks improve real scientific synthesis across papers/theories.
updates.target: Freeze real multi-paper chart packets containing genuinely compatible views, pairwise false friends, context/regime/assumption conflicts, mixed authority layers, cycle/path inconsistencies, disconnected subatlases and nonunique global models. Compare naive source union, pairwise-only gluing, pairwise+cycle checks and full overlap+global-existence+uniqueness contracts under matched model/evidence/evaluator budgets.
updates.falsifier: If pairwise-only gluing matches the full contract on valid global synthesis, obstruction localization and cost across the frozen real benchmark, keep the simpler method and preserve the null.

updates.new_result: Relation-layer typing now controls gluing authority: semantic/mathematical/observational/QoI/mechanistic overlap certifications are explicit and cannot be silently escalated.

updates.note: Round 018 updates the closure inventory but does not yet provide a deterministic current-status registry generator across all immutable backlog deltas.

saturation.reason: Round 018 retained and implemented new local-to-global coherence, global existence/uniqueness and cycle/path obstruction coordinates.
